plugins.name: spec-debate
plugins.changelog: v1.10.0: August 2026 refresh — Codex ChatGPT-account handling (fail fast on non-retryable 400s with actionable hint, preflight warning when codex/ models aren't in the ChatGPT lineup; gpt-5.3-codex retired from ChatGPT accounts), new antigravity/ provider via agy CLI (Gemini CLI's successor; consumer gemini-cli retired 2026-06-18, now warns and is dropped from auto-selection), Claude 5 catalog (claude-fable-5/opus-5/sonnet-5 + Bedrock mappings), codex gpt-5.6 examples, dead deepseek-chat alias removed, litellm floor 1.96, CLI-provider retry loops deduplicated. v1.9.1: codex review fixes — export-tasks/emit-plan token-param fix for Moonshot reasoning models (kimi-k3 default broke both), OPENAI_BASE_URL misroute warning on all litellm paths, Kimi reasoning detection anchored to version segment, o3-pro doc drift reconciled. v1.9.0: July 2026 model catalog refresh — GPT-5.6 line (sol/terra/luna), Moonshot kimi-k3 and kimi-k2.7-code (temperature detection extended), xai/grok-4.5, zai/glm-5.2, gemini-3.6-flash, MiniMax-M2.7; new provider defaults; OPENAI_BASE_URL misroute warning.
